units.text: 5. Qualification requirements for citizens to fill state service positions are established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, as well as by laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. State Service Positions
units.text: 6. A federal state body, a public authority of a federal territory or a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for positions that are not state service positions. The work of employees holding such positions is governed by labor legislation.

units.locator: Article 9. Registers of State Service Positions
units.text: 2. The lists specified in point 1 of this Article are approved by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Registers of State Service Positions
units.text: 3. The register of state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is approved by a law or another normative legal act of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Registers of State Service Positions
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: Article 10. State Servants
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: 1. A federal state servant is a citizen who performs professional official activities in a federal state service position and receives monetary remuneration (compensation, pay and allowances) from the federal budget or the budget of a federal territory.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: 2. A state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is a citizen who performs professional official activities in a state civil service position of that constituent entity and receives monetary remuneration (compensation) from the budget of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation. In cases provided for by a federal law, a state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may also receive monetary remuneration (compensation) from the federal budget.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: 3. The employer of a federal state servant is the Russian Federation; the employer of a state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: 4. The legal position (status) of a federal state servant and a state civil servant of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, including restrictions, obligations, rules of official conduct and liability, as well as the procedure for resolving conflicts of interest and service disputes, is established by the relevant federal law on the type of state service.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. State Servants
units.text: Where a federal law on a type of state service provides for the application of labor legislation to relationships arising in connection with service of that type, such legislation applies insofar as it does not conflict with this Federal Law and the federal law on that type of state service.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 10 · “Where a federal law on a type of state service provides for the…”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: 1. The formation of the state service workforce is ensured through:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: creating a federal personnel reserve, a personnel reserve in a federal state body, a personnel reserve in a public authority of a federal territory, a personnel reserve of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and a personnel reserve in a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation for filling state service positions, as well as effectively using those personnel reserves;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “creating a federal personnel reserve, a personnel reserve in a…”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: developing the professional qualities of state servants;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “developing the professional qualities of state servants;”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: assessing the results of state servants’ professional official activities during performance appraisal or a qualifying examination;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “assessing the results of state servants’ professional official…”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: creating opportunities for the promotion (career advancement) of state servants;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “creating opportunities for the promotion (career advancement)…”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: using modern human resources technologies;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “using modern human resources technologies;”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: applying educational programs and federal state educational standards;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “applying educational programs and federal state educational…”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: rotating state servants.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11 · “rotating state servants.”

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: 2. Federal laws on the types of state service and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation establish the procedure for entering state service and filling vacant state service positions through competition, the conditions for forming competition commissions, and the rules for publishing information on competitions in the mass media, and also provide for other procedures for entering state service and filling vacant state service positions.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: 3. Citizens are trained for state service in the forms established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: 4. Additional professional education of state servants is provided in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Formation of the State Service Workforce
units.text: 5. Federal laws on the types of state service may establish special rules for the rotation of state servants that take account of the specific features of service of the respective type.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 1. Citizens who have command of the state language of the Russian Federation and have reached the age established by the federal law on the relevant type of state service for service of that type are entitled to enter state service under a contract.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: A federal law on a type of state service or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish additional requirements for citizens entering state service under a contract.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 12 · “A federal law on a type of state service or a law of a…”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 1.1. A citizen entering state service and a state servant, in the cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, submit to the state body (public authority of a federal territory) the information and documents, including a questionnaire, necessary for entry into state service and/or for its performance.
units.label: Point 1.1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: A state servant shall inform the state body (public authority of a federal territory) in writing of changes, of which the servant becomes aware, to the information contained in the questionnaire.
units.label: Point 1.1 Art. 12 · “A state servant shall inform the state body (public authority…”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: The questionnaire form, including the list of information to be included in it and the procedure and time limits for updating that information, is established by the President of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by a federal constitutional law or a federal law.
units.label: Point 1.1 Art. 12 · “The questionnaire form, including the list of information to be…”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 2. The terms of contracts, the procedure for concluding them, and the grounds and procedure for terminating them are established in accordance with the federal law on the relevant type of state service.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 3. In accordance with the federal law on the relevant type of state service, a contract may be concluded with a citizen:
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: for an indefinite term;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12 · “for an indefinite term;”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: for a fixed term;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12 · “for a fixed term;”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: for the period of study at a vocational education institution or a higher education institution and for a specified period of state service after completion of that study.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12 · “for the period of study at a vocational education institution…”

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 4. The federal law on a type of state service determines the maximum age for remaining in state service of that type.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 5. The performance of state service includes appointment to a position, assignment of a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank, performance appraisal or a qualifying examination, as well as other circumstances (events) in accordance with this Federal Law, federal laws on the types of state service and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 5.1. State service may be suspended and resumed in the cases and according to the procedure provided for by this Federal Law and federal laws on the types of state service.
units.label: Point 5.1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Entry into, Performance, Suspension, Resumption and Termination of State Service
units.text: 6. The grounds for termination of state service, including the grounds for a state servant’s discharge into the reserve or retirement, are established by this Federal Law and federal laws on the types of state service.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.label: Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 1. State service is subject to suspension in the cases provided for by point 2 of this Article and by federal laws on the types of state service.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 2. State service, other than military service, is suspended when a state servant is called up for military service under mobilization, is assigned to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, concludes a military service contract during a period of mobilization, martial law or wartime, or concludes a contract for voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 3. State service is suspended until the circumstances that constituted the grounds for its suspension cease to exist.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: The period of suspension of state service due to the circumstances provided for by point 2 of this Article also includes the period from the day of completion of military service, service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, or voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, until the day of return to state service, but not more than three months, except in the case provided for by the third paragraph of this point.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12.1 · “The period of suspension of state service due to the…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: The time limit specified in the second paragraph of this point is extended by the period of the state servant’s temporary incapacity for work arising after completion of military service, service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, or voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12.1 · “The time limit specified in the second paragraph of this point…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 4. State service resumes on the day the state servant returns to state service. The state servant is obliged to notify the employer’s representative of that return at least three working days in advance.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 5. During the suspension of state service:
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: retention of the state service position held is guaranteed;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “retention of the state service position held is guaranteed;”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: the rights and duties of the state servant established by the federal law on the type of state service being suspended are not exercised or performed;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “the rights and duties of the state servant established by the…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: the restrictions, prohibitions and requirements associated with holding a state service position, established by the federal law on the type of state service being suspended, do not apply;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “the restrictions, prohibitions and requirements associated with…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: monetary remuneration (compensation, pay and allowances) and other payments made in connection with performance of the state service being suspended do not accrue and are not paid;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “monetary remuneration (compensation, pay and allowances) and…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: social guarantees to which the state servant became entitled through state service before the circumstances provided for by point 2 of this Article arose are retained (social and household support and medical care, and sanatorium and health-resort treatment for the state servant and members of the servant’s family);
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “social guarantees to which the state servant became entitled…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: termination of the contract with the state servant at the initiative of the employer’s representative is not permitted, except where the contract is terminated because the state body (public authority of a federal territory) is abolished or because the contract term expires;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “termination of the contract with the state servant at the…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: the running of the term of a fixed-term contract with the state servant is not suspended, and state service terminates on expiry of that term, unless otherwise established by this Article and/or the federal law on the relevant type of state service.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12.1 · “the running of the term of a fixed-term contract with the state…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 5.1. In the cases provided for by point 2 of this Article, the running of the term of a fixed-term contract is suspended until the day the state servant returns to state service in accordance with point 4 of this Article, except for the running of the term of a fixed-term contract concluded for the performance of a specific assignment or for the period of replacing an absent state servant whose state service position is retained in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 5.1 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 5.2. A fixed-term contract whose term was suspended in accordance with point 5.1 of this Article resumes for a period equal to the remainder of its term calculated as of the day of suspension, but no later than the state servant’s attainment of the maximum age for remaining in state service, unless the state-service relationship has been extended according to the procedure provided for by the federal law on the relevant type of state service and/or that federal law provides otherwise.
units.label: Point 5.2 Art. 12.1
